# GPU Fleet Report

## Overview
This report provides a summary of the GPU fleet, including the count of each GPU model, the driver versions in use, and the current status of each device.

| GPU Model | Count |
|-----------|-------|
| DGX A100 | 4 |
| DGX H100 | 3 |
| HGX H200 | 1 |

| gpu-node-01 | DGX A100 | 550.90.07 | DEVICE_STATUS_ONLINE |

| gpu-node-03 | DGX H100 | 560.35.03 | DEVICE_STATUS_WARNING |
| gpu-node-04 | DGX H100 | 560.35.03 | DEVICE_STATUS_OFFLINE |
| gpu-node-05 | DGX H100 | 535.183.01 | DEVICE_STATUS_WARNING |
| gpu-node-06 | HGX H200 | 560.35.03 | DEVICE_STATUS_OFFLINE |
| gpu-node-07 | DGX A100 | 550.90.07 | DEVICE_STATUS_ONLINE |
| gpu-node-08 | DGX A100 | 560.35.03 | DEVICE_STATUS_ONLINE |

*Status codes:* `DEVICE_STATUS_ONLINE` – device is operational, `DEVICE_STATUS_WARNING` – device reports warnings, `DEVICE_STATUS_OFFLINE` – device is not reachable.
